--- title: bc_dim format: html: css: /man.css --- ## Predict Broadcasted Dimensions {.unnumbered} ### Description bc_dim(x, y) gives the dimensions an array would have, as the result of an broadcasted binary element-wise operation between 2 arrays x and y. ### Usage 
bc_dim(x, y)
### Arguments
x, y an atomic or recursive array.
### Value Returns an integer vector giving the broadcasted dimension sizes of the result, or the length of the result if its dimensions will be NULL.

### Examples ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} library("broadcast") x.dim <- c(4:2) x.len <- prod(x.dim) x.data <- sample(c(TRUE, FALSE, NA), x.len, TRUE) x <- array(x.data, x.dim) y <- array(1:50, c(4,1,1)) dim(bc.b(x, y, "&")) == bc_dim(x, y) #> [1] TRUE TRUE TRUE dim(bc.b(x, y, "|")) == bc_dim(x, y) #> [1] TRUE TRUE TRUE ``` :::
